## Goal

**Feature Goal**: Ship the fourth and final Mulligan agent-callable tool — `mulligan_audit` — whose `execute()` gives the agent a token-aware view of the context THE MODEL ACTUALLY SEES (the filtered view, D5), flagging the biggest contributors against the bloat threshold, listing active Mulligan markers, and suggesting a shrink target. This closes the feedback loop: the agent can see "that one read is ~9k tokens" and decide to shrink/rewind. It is the SINGLE read-only exception in the tool set.

**Deliverable**: `src/tools/audit.ts` replaces the `export {};` stub. Exports: `AuditParams` (typebox VERBATIM spec/05 §4), `AuditArgs = Static<typeof AuditParams>`, `AUDIT_DESC` (spec/05 §5 VERBATIM), `AuditRow` + `AuditDetails` interfaces, the PURE `renderAuditReport(...)` renderer (unit-testable, no `ctx`), and `auditTool: ToolDefinition<typeof AuditParams, AuditDetails>` (a PLAIN `export const` — NO `makeAuditTool(pi)` factory; see Decision below). Plus `test/tools/audit.test.ts` mirroring the sibling test idiom.

**Success Definition**: `mulligan_audit` returns a markdown report whose total reflects the FILTERED (not raw) count, names the largest message in the Suggestion, respects `top`-N, flags bloat above `config.nudges.bloatThresholdBytes`, and the E16 fallback (no `rt.lastFiltered`) renders with confidence "low" without crashing. Never throws; never persists; never touches `pi`; never calls `ctx.getContextUsage()`.

## Why

- Closes the rewind/shrink feedback loop: without an honest token breakdown, the agent cannot tell which message to shrink or whether a rewind "worked." D5 (the audit MUST report the filtered view, never `getContextUsage`) is the whole reason the tool exists.
- The four tools share a milestone ("four registered tools with stable names/descriptions/parameter shapes"). audit is the read-only counterpart to the three write tools (rewind/shrink/checkpoint, all SHIPPED).
- Read-only + persist-nothing ⇒ the safest tool in the set: it cannot corrupt session state.

## What

The agent calls `mulligan_audit({ top?: number })`. It receives `{ content: [{ type:"text", text: <markdown report> }], details: AuditDetails }`. The report format is VERBATIM spec/05 §4 (see Context §"Report format"). `top` defaults to 8; only the "Top messages" block is truncated — the TOTAL is over ALL filtered messages.

### Success Criteria

- [ ] Report total reflects the FILTERED view (D5); a rewind that hides N messages is reflected as a lower total.
- [ ] E16 fallback (rt.lastFiltered null) renders with `confidence: "low"` and `source: "fallback"` without crashing.
- [ ] `top`-N respected (default 8); suggestion names rows[0].label (the largest).
- [ ] Messages above `config.nudges.bloatThresholdBytes` carry the ⚠ flag.
- [ ] Never throws (E13); config disabled → refusal (E14); never persists; never calls `pi.*` / `ctx.getContextUsage()`.

Formatting rules (load-bearing):
- Total line: `Total (filtered): ~<N> tokens  (estimate, confidence: <c>)` — TWO spaces before `(estimate`.
- Active markers: `<n> rewind (<distinct granularities comma-joined>), <n> shrink, <n> checkpoints [<names comma-joined>]`. Empty checkpoint set renders `[]`. Distinct rewind granularities (dedup) so e.g. two last_tool_call_group rewinds → `2 rewind (last_tool_call_group)`.
- Protected: `will not rewind past <config.rewind.protectedRoles.join("/")>` (e.g. `first:user/latest:user`). Empty list → `none`.
- Each top row: right-aligned 6-wide token count (`String(tokens).padStart(6)`), 11-wide padded role (`role.padEnd(11)`), then label, then (if bloaty) `  ⚠ above bloat threshold (<Math.round(thresholdBytes/1024)> KB)`.
- Empty filtered view → render `No messages in filtered view.` and OMIT the Suggestion.
- Suggestion names rows[0].label (the largest): `Suggestion: the `<label>` result is the largest contributor. Consider mulligan_shrink.`

### Implementation Tasks (ordered by dependencies)

The split into two files (src/tools/audit.ts + test/tools/audit.test.ts) follows the TDD-flavored sibling idiom. Pure helpers (isRecord, readOwn, readStr, describeMessage, buildCallLookup, messageBytes, listCheckpoints, renderAuditReport) live INSIDE audit.ts as module-private (or EXPORTED where unit-testability is desired: renderAuditReport, describeMessage, buildCallLookup, messageBytes, listCheckpoints — mirror the oracle which exports these for direct testing). Keep them Pi-free (take data, not ctx) so they are unit-testable in isolation.

### Implementation Patterns & Key Details

```ts
async function auditExecute(_toolCallId, params, _signal, _onUpdate, ctx): Promise<AgentToolResult<AuditDetails>> {
  try {
    const config = getConfig();
    if (!config.enabled) return refusal("Mulligan is disabled"); 
    const rt = runtime(ctx.sessionManager); 
    let filtered: Record<string, unknown>[];
    let source: "cached"|"fallback";
    let confidence: "low"|"medium"|"high";
    if (Array.isArray(rt.lastFiltered)) {
      filtered = rt.lastFiltered; source = "cached"; confidence = config.audit.estimateConfidence;
    } else {
      const entries = ctx.sessionManager.buildContextEntries();
      const base = entriesToMessages(entries); 
      const branch = ctx.sessionManager.getBranch().slice().reverse();
      filtered = filterPipeline(base as unknown as MessageLike[], readMarkers(ctx), config, branch as unknown as BranchEntry[]);
      source = "fallback"; confidence = "low";
    }
    const totalTokens = estimateTokens(filtered as unknown as Parameters<typeof estimateTokens>[0]).tokens;
    const top = typeof params?.top === "number" && params.top > 0 ? Math.floor(params.top) : 8;
    const callLookup = buildCallLookup(filtered);
    const threshold = config.nudges.bloatThresholdBytes; 
    const ranked = filtered.map((m) => ({ tokens: estimateTokens([m] as unknown as Parameters<typeof estimateTokens>[0]).tokens, msg: m }))
                           .sort((a,b) => b.tokens - a.tokens).slice(0, top);
    const rows: AuditRow[] = ranked.map(({tokens,msg}) => ({ tokens, role: readStr(msg,"role") ?? "?", label: describeMessage(msg, callLookup), bloaty: messageBytes(msg) > threshold, thresholdBytes: threshold }));
    const markers = readMarkers(ctx);
    const checkpointNames = listCheckpoints(ctx.sessionManager.getEntries() as unknown[]);
    const report = renderAuditReport({ totalTokens, confidence, rewinds: markers.rewinds as RewindMarker[], shrinks: markers.shrinks as ShrinkMarker[], checkpointNames, protectedRoles: config.rewind.protectedRoles, rows, filtered });
    return { content: [{ type: "text" as const, text: report }], details: { totalTokens, confidence, source, nRewinds: markers.rewinds.length, nShrinks: markers.shrinks.length, nCheckpoints: checkpointNames.length, top: rows } };
  } catch (e) {
    const reason = e instanceof Error ? e.message : String(e);
    return { content: [{ type: "text" as const, text: `Mulligan: audit failed — ${reason}` }], details: { totalTokens: 0, confidence: "low", source: "fallback", nRewinds: 0, nShrinks: 0, nCheckpoints: 0, top: [], error: reason } };
  }
}
export const auditTool: ToolDefinition<typeof AuditParams, AuditDetails> = defineTool({
  name: "mulligan_audit", label: "Mulligan Audit", description: AUDIT_DESC, parameters: AuditParams,
  async execute(toolCallId, params, signal, onUpdate, ctx) { return auditExecute(toolCallId, params, signal, onUpdate, ctx); },
});

```

Helper sketches (Pi-free, defensive via readOwn, NEVER throw — mirror tokens.ts/filter.ts):
- `entriesToMessages(entries)`: `entries.flatMap(e => { try { const m = sessionEntryToContextMessages(e); return Array.isArray(m) ? m.filter(isRecord) : []; } catch { return []; } })`.
- `describeMessage(msg, callLookup)`: toolResult → `${toolName} ${briefArgs}` (briefArgs prefers the MATCHED assistant toolCall's args via callLookup: path/file_path→command→query/pattern/search_query, truncated 40); assistant → `(thinking + toolCall x2)`-style block-count summary; user → `user "<snippet>"`; custom → customType; else role|"message".
- `buildCallLookup(messages)`: scan assistant messages' content for toolCall blocks → Map<toolCallId,{name,args}> (so toolResult labels can name the call).
- `messageBytes(msg)`: string content → Buffer.byteLength(s,"utf8"); array content → resultBytes(content) (reuse tokens.ts); else 0.
- `listCheckpoints(entries)`: latest-wins label map (a clear entry sets undefined overwriting a prior set) → emit active `mulligan:checkpoint:` names in first-occurrence order, prefix stripped. (Mirror rewind.ts checkpointExists latest-wins logic — a consumed checkpoint must NOT stay listed.)
- `refusal(reason)`: `{ content:[{type:"text",text:`Mulligan: refused — ${reason}.`}], details:{totalTokens:0,confidence:"low",source:"fallback",nRewinds:0,nShrinks:0,nCheckpoints:0,top:[]} }`.

successCriteria.description: src/tools/audit.ts replaces the `export {};` stub and exports AuditParams, AuditArgs, AUDIT_DESC, AuditRow, AuditDetails, renderAuditReport, describeMessage, buildCallLookup, messageBytes, listCheckpoints, and auditTool.

auditTool is a PLAIN `export const auditTool: ToolDefinition<typeof AuditParams, AuditDetails>` (NO makeAuditTool(pi) factory) — audit needs no `pi`; index.ts (P1.M7.T1.S1) will do `pi.registerTool(auditTool)` directly. name==="mulligan_audit", label==="Mulligan Audit", description===AUDIT_DESC (spec/05 §5 VERBATIM), parameters===AuditParams.

AuditParams is the typebox VERBATIM spec/05 §4 schema: a single optional `top` number field with the exact description string ("Report only the top N messages by token size. Default 8."). top defaults to 8 when absent/non-positive.

D5 (load-bearing): the total token count is computed from the FILTERED view via estimateTokens(filtered).tokens — NEVER ctx.getContextUsage() (which counts hidden/rewound tokens). No call to getContextUsage appears anywhere in src/tools/audit.ts.

PRIMARY path: when runtime(ctx.sessionManager).lastFiltered is a non-null array, the audit uses it directly; details.source==="cached" and the reported confidence === config.audit.estimateConfidence (default "medium").

E16 FALLBACK path: when rt.lastFiltered is null, the audit calls buildContextEntries().flatMap(sessionEntryToContextMessages) (via the canonical Pi helper, defensive), then re-runs filterPipeline(messages, readMarkers(ctx), config, getBranch().slice().reverse()) so the report reflects post-rewind/shrink reality; details.source==="fallback" and confidence==="low". No crash.

The report matches spec/05 §4 VERBATIM: the `## Mulligan audit — context you are currently carrying` header; `Total (filtered): ~<N> tokens  (estimate, confidence: <c>)` (TWO spaces before "(estimate"); `Active markers: <n> rewind (<distinct granularities>), <n> shrink, <n> checkpoints [<names>|[]]`; `Protected: will not rewind past <roles join "/">.`; `Top messages by size:` with right-aligned token counts; `Suggestion: the `<largest label>` result is the largest contributor. Consider mulligan_shrink.`
top-N is respected: only the Top-messages block is truncated to `top` (default 8); the TOTAL is over ALL filtered messages (estimateTokens(filtered)).tokens.

Bloat flag: a message whose in-context bytes (messageBytes — UTF-8 for string content, resultBytes for array content) STRICTLY exceed config.nudges.bloatThresholdBytes (default 8192) is flagged `⚠ above bloat threshold (<Math.round(thresholdBytes/1024)> KB)`. v1 uses the SINGLE global threshold for all messages (no per-tool bloatThresholdFor — that is a P3/P4 refinement; v1 nudges.ts does not export it).
Suggestion names rows[0].label (the largest message). When the filtered view is empty, the report renders `No messages in filtered view.` and the Suggestion is OMITTED.

Active markers reflect readMarkers(ctx) counts (rewinds + shrinks) PLUS checkpoints scanned from getEntries() (LabelEntries with `mulligan:checkpoint:` prefix, prefix-stripped, latest-wins so a consumed checkpoint is not listed). Distinct rewind granularities are comma-joined (dedup).

config.enabled === false → refusal text `Mulligan: refused — Mulligan is disabled.` BEFORE any session access (E14 + D5 — when disabled the model sees the unfiltered view); details is the all-zero AuditDetails. No config.audit.enabled sub-gate is invented (none exists).

Never throws (E13): the WHOLE execute body is ONE try/catch; any exception (throwing getSessionId/buildContextEntries/getEntries/Proxy trap) → failure text `Mulligan: audit failed — <reason>` + details.error set; no throw escapes the tool.

EVERY return path (success + refusal + catch) includes a non-undefined `details` object satisfying AuditDetails (totalTokens, confidence, source, nRewinds, nShrinks, nCheckpoints, top[]; catch path also sets error?). Required under strict mode (GOTCHA #4).
The audit PERSISTS NOTHING — it makes NO pi.* calls (no appendEntry/sendMessage/setLabel) and no `pi` is captured (no factory, no module-scoped pi). It is purely read-only via ctx + pure helpers.

All intra-project imports use `.js` extensions (tokens.js, runtime.js, config.js, transforms.js, filter.js, markers.js type-only) — ESM + vitest resolution (GOTCHA). sessionEntryToContextMessages is imported from the package root `@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent`.

Pure helpers (renderAuditReport, describeMessage, buildCallLookup, messageBytes, listCheckpoints) take DATA not ctx — directly unit-testable. They read defensively via readOwn (a throwing Proxy trap never crashes them).

test/tools/audit.test.ts is created and passes, mirroring the shrink.test.ts/checkpoint.test.ts idiom (vitest, hand-rolled makeCtx with NO vi.fn and NO makePi — audit needs no pi, so the test imports auditTool directly; clearAll()+setConfig(undefined) before/after; run()/firstText() helpers; expectTypeOf), covering registration metadata, cached-path report (largest-first + bloat flag + suggestion), fallback-path low-confidence-no-crash, top-N, suggestion-naming + empty-omission, bloat boundary (8192 not flagged / 8193 flagged), active-markers line + checkpoint scan, config-disabled refusal, never-throws, details-on-every-path, the D5 no-getContextUsage regression, and PURE renderer/helper unit cases.
